definitions.explanation: The first train or bus of the day on a particular route.
The station where a train or bus begins its route.

examples.japanese: {始発|しはつ}{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}る。
{始発|しはつ}は5{時|じ}30{分|ぷん}です。
この{駅|えき}は{始発|しはつ}{駅|えき}なので、{座|すわ}れる。
examples.english: Since this is the originating station, I can get a seat.

notes:
{始発|しはつ} combines {始|し} (begin) + {発|はつ} (departure).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {始発|しはつ}{電車|でんしゃ}/{始発|しはつ}バス (first train/bus)
- {始発|しはつ}{駅|えき} (originating station)
- {始発|しはつ}に{乗|の}る (to catch the first train)

RELATED TERMS:
- {終電|しゅうでん} (last train) - antonym
- {終発|しゅうはつ} (last departure)
- {終点|しゅうてん} (terminal station) - opposite of {始発|しはつ}{駅|えき}

USAGE NOTES:
- {始発|しはつ} alone often means "first train" in context
- Useful word for commuters and travelers in Japan
